The '''Feddasyr system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Feddasyr]].
